definitions.explanation: The line along a beach where waves wash up onto the sand. The boundary between water and shore that shifts with each wave.

examples.japanese: {波打|なみう}ち{際|ぎわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked along the water's edge.

examples.japanese: {波打|なみう}ち{際|ぎわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{貝殻|かいがら}→貝殻：19457_kaigara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}った→拾う：00845_hirou⟧。
examples.english: I picked up seashells at the water's edge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{波打|なみう}ち{際|ぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{足跡|あしあと}→足跡：04095_ashiato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Two sets of footprints remained at the water's edge in the twilight.

notes:
An evocative word that paints a vivid picture of the beach. It specifically refers to the dynamic zone where waves break and wash onto shore — not just any part of the beach. Common in literary descriptions and travel writing.

FORMS:
{波打|なみう}つ (waves breaking) + {際|ぎわ} (edge, boundary)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波打|なみう}ち{際|ぎわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk along the water's edge
- {波打|なみう}ち{際|ぎわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play at the water's edge
- {波打|なみう}ち{際|ぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げられる→打ち上げる：06732_uchiageru⟧: to wash up on the shore
- {波打|なみう}ち{際|ぎわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧: sand at the water's edge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{浜辺|はまべ}→浜辺：17948_hamabe⟧: beach, seashore — the whole sandy area, not just the water line
- ⟦{水際|みずぎわ}→水際：10686_mizugiwa⟧: water's edge — more general; can refer to any body of water
- {渚|なぎさ}: shore, beach — a more literary and poetic synonym
